ownership.quote: Hetzner Online GmbH began operations in Germany in 1997 under the name Hetzner Online Services. ... The company is named after its founder Martin Hetzner.

stage.quote: Founder Martin Hetzner ... Key people Martin Hetzner (CEO)
stage.note: No evidence of any external VC/equity funding round; Hetzner is a privately held, founder/family-controlled German GmbH (formerly an AG until 2015) operating profitably since 1997. No Crunchbase-listed funding rounds found.

revenue.basis: Wikipedia infobox citing Hetzner Online GmbH's filed German annual financial statement (Jahresabschluss) on Bundesanzeiger for fiscal year 2021; €367 million converted at roughly 1.09 USD/EUR (approx.). Figure is several years old; no more recent public figure found within research time budget.

note: Hetzner Online GmbH is a privately held, founder-led (Martin Hetzner) German hosting/dedicated-server/cloud company founded in 1997, headquartered in Gunzenhausen, Bavaria, with data centers in Germany, Finland, the US (colocation), and Singapore. It appears to be self-funded/profitable (net income €103M on revenue €367M for FY2021 per its Bundesanzeiger filing) with no external VC funding found; not an accelerator alum, not a subsidiary of a larger company, and not publicly traded.
